title: Incorrect Date of Birth Recorded
quote: Your patient profile is set up and your date of birth is July 4th.
problem: The receptionist recorded an incorrect date of birth for the patient.
expected: The receptionist should have confirmed the patient's date of birth before recording it in the profile.

title: Appointment scheduled on non-existent date
quote: Your appointment is set for tomorrow, Tuesday, August 18th at 8:15 AM
problem: The date 'Tuesday, August 18th' is incorrect because August 18th does not fall on a Tuesday in 2023.
expected: The receptionist should have confirmed the correct weekday for August 18th, 2023, which is a Friday.

title: Inconsistent provider naming
problem: The receptionist provided inconsistent spelling for the doctor's name, which may cause confusion.
expected: The receptionist should use a consistent and correct spelling: Dr. Zbigniew Łukawski.

title: Incorrect clinic name in office hours
quote: Davenport Orthopedics is open Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday
problem: The receptionist referred to 'Davenport Orthopedics' instead of 'Pivot Point Orthopedics', potentially confusing the patient about the clinic's identity.
expected: The receptionist should provide the correct office hours for 'Pivot Point Orthopedics'.

title: Agent dead-ended patient without resolution
quote: I can't proceed further right now, but I can make sure our clinic support team follows up with you. Would you like me to connect you to our patient support team?
problem: The agent offered to connect to the patient support team but did not resolve the task of rescheduling or clearly explain what would happen next.
expected: The agent should have confirmed that connecting the patient to support would allow them to reschedule immediately.

title: Task failure - unable to reschedule appointment
quote: I can't proceed further right now, but I can make sure our clinic support team follows up with you. Would you like me to connect you to our patient support team?
problem: The receptionist failed to assist the patient in rescheduling her appointment, which was the initial request, effectively dead-ending the call without resolving the patient's need.
expected: The receptionist should have either directly assisted in rescheduling the appointment or clearly explained why it could not be done immediately, providing a clear next step.

title: Transfer terminated incorrectly
quote: I'm unable to find your record in our system, so I can't schedule your appointment right now. I'll connect you to our Patient Support Team for help. Please stay on the line. Transferring you now. Thank you. Hello, you've reached the Pretty Good AI Test Line. Goodbye.
problem: The receptionist promised to transfer the patient to the Patient Support Team but instead redirected them to a test line and terminated the call.
expected: The receptionist should have successfully transferred the patient to the Patient Support Team or provided a valid method of contact for further assistance.

title: Contradiction in name spelling request
quote: Thank you. Could you please spell your last name as well?
problem: The receptionist asked the patient to spell their last name again immediately after it was just spelled out.
expected: The receptionist should have accepted the provided spelling of the last name without asking for it again.

title: Failed patient record lookup
quote: I'm unable to locate your record in our system. I can connect you to our patient support team for help.
problem: The receptionist failed to locate the patient's record despite confirming the name, phone number, and date of birth, potentially missing an opportunity for resolution within the call.
expected: The receptionist should have successfully located the patient record using the confirmed details or offered more specific assistance or troubleshooting steps before transferring.

title: Failed to Capture and Acknowledge Details
quote: Could you read back the details you noted from me?
problem: The receptionist failed to acknowledge that no personal details were provided by the patient, leading to confusion when asked to read back details not given.
expected: The receptionist should have directly responded that no personal details were provided yet.

title: Abrupt call termination
quote: Hello, you've reached the pretty good AI test line. Goodbye.
problem: The receptionist ended the call abruptly after attempting to transfer the patient, without resolving the situation or ensuring the transfer succeeded.
expected: The receptionist should ensure a successful transfer to the patient support team or provide further assistance to resolve the issue with accessing MRI results.

title: Dead-end without resolution
quote: Hello, you've reached the Pretty Good AI test line. Goodbye.
problem: The receptionist failed to connect the patient to the support team and ended the call without resolving the issue.
expected: The receptionist should have successfully connected the patient to the live patient support team instead of disconnecting the call.

title: Inconsistent Clinic Name Mention
quote: Yes, Getterpoi Orthopedics does offer cortisone shots for joint and muscle conditions.
problem: The receptionist mentions 'Getterpoi Orthopedics' instead of 'Pivot Point Orthopedics,' which is the name given at the start of the call. This could confuse the caller about whether they are contacting the correct clinic.
expected: The receptionist should consistently refer to the clinic as 'Pivot Point Orthopedics.'

title: Missed clinically urgent situation
quote: Hi, I fell off a ladder this morning, my wrist looks crooked, and my fingers are numb and cold. I’d like to book an appointment for next week.
problem: The receptionist treated the call as routine despite signs of a potentially serious injury that could require immediate medical attention.
expected: The receptionist should have recognized the symptoms as potentially urgent and advised the patient to seek immediate medical evaluation.

title: Dead-ended the caller without resolving anything
quote: Hello, you've reached the Pretty Good AI Test Line. Goodbye.
problem: The call was ended without addressing the patient's request for an appointment or providing any information.
expected: The receptionist should have either scheduled an appointment or directed the patient on how to proceed, especially given the urgent nature of the symptoms described.

title: Receptionist gave different answers for practice_name
problem: Across 12 calls the receptionist stated 2 different values for practice_name. At most one can be correct.
expected: The same practice_name on every call.
